# XRD scattering-factor data

`web/design/xrd-scattering-params.js` contains the atomic X-ray scattering parameter table distributed with Pymatgen (`pymatgen/analysis/diffraction/atomic_scattering_params.json`). It was byte-compared against the pinned Pymatgen 2026.10.24 / pymatgen-core 2026.10.16 environment; the 99-element JSON data are identical (source JSON SHA-256 `c675301248bb86ea359428f20c3987d719b1ac1a779166ef27e1d0f652467d93`). The associated Pymatgen license is in [`pymatgen/LICENSE`](./pymatgen/LICENSE).

The browser powder-diffraction calculation follows the local read-only `macer/utils/crystal_tools.py` implementation and Pymatgen `XRDCalculator` structure-factor and Lorentz–polarization equations. macer-rust's Cu source wavelengths and Kα mixture weights come from that local `crystal_tools.py`; see the repository's implementation evidence for exact revisions and validation. Profile broadening uses unit-area Gaussian and Lorentzian kernels; Lorentzian `γ` is the half-width at half-maximum. The legacy macer utility divides its Lorentzian by an extra `γ`, so the browser intentionally fixes that area normalization while retaining relative display scaling.
